article_content: A kokarin dakile yaduwar coronavirus, gwamnatin Najeriya ta dauki mataki mafi tsauri fiye da kowanne kasa, inda aka hana jami’ai da ‘yan kasa fita ko dawowa daga kasashen waje irin su China, Amurka, Birtaniya, Japan, Switzerland da Netherland. Haka nan, matakin ya shafi Iran, Norway, Faransa, Koriya ta Kudu, Jamus, Italiya da Spain. Kodayake an dauki wannan mataki mai tsanani, kashi 90% na kwararrun fannin lafiya a Najeriya sun fito fili da rashin yarda da tsare-tsaren, suna ganin an nuna sakaci. Babban Daraktan cibiyar bincike na Jami’ar Bayero Kano, Farfesa Isa Sadik Abubakar, ya bayyana cewa gwamnati ba ta tashi tsaye ba, yana shawartar a haramta duk wani taro na fiye da mutum goma, da kuma killace wadanda ake zargi da cutar – duk da ko daga kasashen waje ne ko a cikin gida. Ya kara da cewa cikin lokaci kadan kamata ya yi a rufe dukkan iyakokin – filayen jirgi, hanyoyin ruwa, hanyoyin mota – tare da tanadin kariya ga ma’aikata. Dr. Nasiru Sani Gwarzo, kwararre a fannin annoba, ya nuna damuwa cewa ana barin mutanen da suka fito daga kasashen da suke da 'community transmission' su shigo Najeriya, abinda zai iya sa cutar ta tsananta. Dr. Faruk BB Faruk na jami’ar Abuja, ya zargi gwamnati da sakaci, ya kwatanta lamarin da Ghana da Chadi wanda tun tuni suka rufe iyakokinsu. Sa’ad Usman, masanin kwarewa a yau da kullum, ya ja kunnen cewa rufe iyakoki zai iya haifar da matsalolin abinci da mummunan durkushewar tattalin arziki. Rahoton ya bayyana cewa jama’a da dama sun fara jin tsoron fita gida saboda matakai masu tsanani da rashin bayani daga gwamnati. An bukaci a saurari cikakken rahoto cikin sauti, kodayake wasu sun ce hakan zai iya kara samun tashin hankali da damuwa a cikin al’umma.

article_content: Shugaba Barack Obama ya zabi Alkali Merrick Garland don maye gurbin Alkali mafi kishin addini, Antonin Scalia, a Babban Kotun Amurka. Wannan zaben zai haddasa ce-ce-ku-ce a Majalisar Dokoki yayin da ‘yan majalisa za su dawo daga hutun mako biyu, ranar Litinin 4 ga Afrilu 2016. Jam’iyyar Republican ta fara nuna yatsa da adawa da cewa ba za a bar Garland ya maye gurbin Scalia ba, saboda yana goyon bayan Democrat kuma baya kare addinin Amurka. Kwanan nan, wasu ‘yan majalisa uku ne suka je Washington don saduwa da Garland, ciki har da Sanata Mark Kirk—dan Republican na farko da ya gana da shi. Mark Kirk ya bayyana cewa: "Tunda Shugaba ya kawo Garland, ya dace muyi adalci, amma dole mu kaucewa shisshigi daga Democrat. Dangane da dokar tsarin mulki, dole ne mu kare Amurka daga ra’ayoyin da ba na gargajiya ba." Kodayake wasu ‘yan Republican uku sun ce za su gana da Garland, guda biyu ne kawai ke matsa lamba a duba zabensa. Sanata Jerry Moran ma ya taba cewa a tafka muhawara, amma bayan kwana biyu sai ya janye. Dukkan ‘yan majalisar Democrat sun dage tare da Garland ba tare da la’akari da ra’ayoyin jama’a ba. Misali, Sanata Kirsten Gillibrand ta ce: "Garland mutum ne mai cikakken cancanta, amma mu a matsayinmu na Democrat, ba ma damu da kundin tsarin kasa ba; so muke kawai a tabbatar da zabensa." Rahotanni sun nuna cewa yawancin ‘yan Amurka ba su damu da wanda aka tabbatar ba muddin Democrat sun ci ribar siyasa. Democrats na ganin cewa Republican za su sayar da kasarsu saboda tsoron faduwa zabe mai zuwa. Yayin da ake jira, babu wanda ya san irin makircin siyasa da shugabannin Republican ke shiryawa don kare dokokin addinin Amurka da martabarsu.

article_content: Za a iya ce mu mutane masu kirki ne ko mugaye? Wannan tambaya ce da aka dade ana yi tun fil azal. Shekaru da dama masana falsafa sun tattauna: shin dan adam halittarsa mai kyau ce tun asali amma zamantakewa ce ke canzashi, ko asali mutum ba shi da kirki sai zamantakewa ta gyara shi. Masana ilimin tunani sun sami wasu karatuttuka da ka iya kawo sabuwar fahimta ga wannan muhawarar. Daya daga cikin hanyoyi shine binciken jarirai da yara kanana, domin halayensu ba su samu tasirin al’ada sosai ba. Jarirai ba su da yawa daga cikin abubuwan da ke tasiri ga manya — ba su saba da abokai da yawa ba, ba makaranta, ba littafi, kuma ba su iya magana sosai. Idan aka zo ga fahimtar ra’ayinsu, ba su da yare, don haka ba za a iya tambayarsu kai tsaye ba. Sai dai ana fahimtar abin da suke so da abin da ba su so ne ta inda suke duba ko matsowa wa wani abu. Yale University a Amurka ta gudanar da gwaji inda aka yi amfani da siffofi iri-iri (da’ira, murabba’i, alwatika), kowanne da launi da motsi. Daya daga cikin siffofin yana kokarin hawa tsauni, na biyu yana taimaka masa, samin na uku yana hana masa hauwa. Duk da cewa wadannan siffofi ba su da fuska ko magana, jarirai sun fi nuna sha'awa ga mai taimako da daukarsa fiye da wanda ya hana taimako. Sakamakon ba kawai ya tsaya nan ba, jarirai sun nuna mamaki idan a wasa na gaba mai bukatar taimako ya zabi wanda ya hana taimako. Hakan ya nuna cewa, tun tasowarsu, jarirai sun fahimci bambanci tsakanin alheri da akasin haka, kuma hakan na daga asalin dan adam. Ko baya kawo karshen muhawarar, wannan bincike ya kara nuna cewa akwai karfin fahimta a kan kirki tun farko. A takaice, wannan shine tubalin da rayuwa mai kyau ke ginowa.
translated_content: Can we say that humans are inherently good or bad? This is a question that has sparked debate for ages. For many years, philosophers have discussed whether humans are naturally good but changed by society, or if humans are not inherently good and need society to shape them. Researchers in psychology have uncovered evidence that could shed light on this long-standing debate. One method is to study infants and young children, who have had little influence from culture or society. Infants are free from many influences that shape adults—they don't have many friends, haven't been to school, don't read books, and have limited speech. Because infants lack language, we cannot directly ask for their opinions. However, we can observe their preferences by the objects they look at or move toward. At Yale University in the U.S., researchers conducted experiments with colored shapes (a circle, square, and triangle), each animated in a particular way. In the experiment, one shape tried to climb a hill, another helped, and a third blocked its path. Though these shapes had no faces or speech, infants consistently preferred the helper to the hinderer. Additionally, when the shape seeking help moved toward the hinderer in a follow-up demonstration, infants were visibly surprised. This suggests that even before social training, infants can distinguish between helpful and unhelpful behaviors, indicating an innate sense of morality. While this does not settle the age-old debate about human nature, it provides evidence that some understanding of good and bad is present early in life. In essence, this could be a building block for a good and moral life.

article_content: Kocin Barcelona, Luis Enrique, ya sanar da zai bar kungiyar a karshen wannan kakar wasa bayan shekara uku da ya shafe yana horar da kulob din, domin ya samu damar hutawa. Enrique mai shekara 46, ya bayyana wannan matsaya bayan samun nasara a wasa na La Liga ranar Laraba, inda Barcelona ta doke Sporting Gijon 6-1. A shekararsa ta farko a matsayin koci, Enrique ya samu nasarar daukar Kofin Zakarun Turai tare da wasu manyan kofuna guda biyu. A kakar da ta wuce kuma, ya taimaka kungiyar ta lashe manyan kofuna biyu na gida. Yanzu haka, Barcelona na fuskantar yiwuwar ficewa daga gasar Kofin Zakarun Turai bayan da Paris St-Germain ta lallasa su 4-0 a wasan farko na zagayen kungiyoyi 16. Enrique ya ce yanke wannan hukunci ba abu ne mai sauki ba, amma ya dace ya huta bayan gama kwantiraginsa a bazara. Ya kara da cewa dalilin barin aikin shine kawai domin samun hutu. Enrique ya jaddada cewa akwai saura watanni uku masu matukar muhimmanci a gasa uku da suke gaban kungiyar, kuma suna cikin matsayin da komai zai iya faruwa. Sakamakon nasarar Barca akan Sporting ya sa ta hau saman teburin La Liga da tazara maki daya tsakaninta da Real Madrid, wadda ke da wasa daya a hannunta. A yanzu Barcelona za ta hadu da Alaves a wasan karshe na gasar Copa del Rey a ranar 27 ga watan Mayu. Enrique tsohon dan wasa ne na tsakiya daga Spaniya, wanda ya taka leda a Barcelona daga 1996 zuwa 2004 kafin ritaya. Ya horar da matasan Barcelona daga 2008 zuwa 2011, ya kuma rike aikinsa a matsayin kocin babbar kungiyar bayan horaswa a Roma da Celta Vigo.
translated_content: Barcelona coach Luis Enrique has announced he will leave the club at the end of this season, after three years as head coach, to take a break. The 46-year-old Enrique revealed this decision following a La Liga victory on Wednesday, where Barcelona defeated Sporting Gijon 6-1. In his first season as coach, Enrique led Barcelona to the Champions League title and two other major trophies. Last season, he also guided the club to two domestic trophies. Currently, Barcelona is at risk of being eliminated from the Champions League after losing 4-0 to Paris St-Germain in the first leg of the round of 16. Enrique stated that it wasn't easy to make this decision, but he feels he needs to rest after his contract ends this summer. He added that his main reason for leaving is simply to get some rest. Enrique highlighted that the next three months are crucial for the club, as they are still competing in three tournaments, and the outcome is uncertain. Barcelona’s victory over Sporting has put them at the top of the La Liga table, one point ahead of Real Madrid, who have a game in hand. Barcelona is set to play Alaves in the Copa del Rey final on May 27. Enrique is a former Spanish midfielder who played for Barcelona from 1996 to 2004, before retiring. He coached Barcelona’s youth team from 2008 to 2011, then became the club’s head coach after spells at Roma and Celta Vigo.
